title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;

description:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Information Technology Coordinator
description:
IT Coordinator / Technical Virtual Assistant

Remote · Contractor · PST Hours


We’re looking for an IT Coordinator / Technical Virtual Assistant to join a fast-growing, remote-first scale-up and work closely with the Director of Tech .


This role sits at the intersection of support, systems, and improvement . Yes, you’ll handle day-to-day IT needs: Onboarding, access, troubleshooting, but you’ll also have a seat at the table when it comes to improving how things work.


If you enjoy fixing problems and thinking about how to prevent them next time, this role will feel rewarding.


What you’ll actually be doing:

You’ll be the go-to person for keeping internal tech running smoothly. That means onboarding new hires, managing access across Google Workspace and other tools, and helping teammates when they hit everyday technical issues like 2FA errors, permissions, or spreadsheet hiccups.

But this role doesn’t stop at “fixing tickets.”


You’ll work directly with the Director of Tech to:

  • Test new tools and workflows before they’re rolled out
  • Brainstorm better ways to handle onboarding, access, and internal requests
  • Turn recurring problems into cleaner, more reliable processes
  • Improve Slack workflows, reminders, and internal systems
  • Help raise the overall security and structure of a fully remote setup

There’s room here to experiment , suggest ideas , and build small but meaningful improvements that make everyone’s day easier.


What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Comfortable supporting internal teams in an IT, ops, or technical support capacity
  • Confident working with Google Workspace and Google Sheets
  • Familiar with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript at a basic level
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and calm when things break
  • Curious about security best practices, especially in remote environments
  • Comfortable collaborating, asking questions, and thinking through solutions


You don’t need to be a senior engineer. You do need to enjoy being hands-on, reliable, and thoughtful about how systems are built and maintained.


Role details

  • Fully remote (contractor-based)
  • Working hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (1-hour break)
  • Rate: USD 6–10/hour , depending on technical experience, and location
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Annual performance-based bonus


Interested?

If you’re looking for a role where you can support, improve, and help shape internal tech , while working closely with a Director of Tech who values ideas and initiative, we’d love to hear from you!

title: DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.


Resultados esperados incluem a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

title: Financial Virtual Assistant with AI Experience
description:
We are seeking a Financial Automation Analyst who is skilled in bookkeeping, accounting logic, financial forecasting, and AI automation.

This role combines traditional accounting with modern AI-driven automation , helping us build a next-generation financial system for our construction business.

You will be responsible for:

  • Daily bookkeeping (Google Sheets + QuickBooks Online)
  • Job costing (materials, labor, subcontractors, per-project margins)
  • Building forecasts (cash flow, profitability, revenue projections)
  • Automating financial workflows using AI, OCR, and Zapier
  • Designing dashboards for the CEO and leadership team
  • Tracking incurred vs. projected expenses
  • Reducing manual workload through integrated automations

This is a long-term role with major growth opportunity as we scale to an AI-powered finance department.

Key Responsibilities 1. Bookkeeping & Financial Management
  • Categorize and reconcile daily transactions in QuickBooks Online
  • Import, organize, and validate bank feeds using AI rules + Sheets formulas
  • Maintain accurate job costing for:
  • Labor
  • Materials
  • Subcontractors
  • Permits
  • Change orders
  • Match receipts from JobTread, WhatsApp, Slack, and email
  • Monitor overdue vendor/subcontractor payments
  • Maintain Profit First accounts and weekly allocation reports


2. Google Sheets Financial System Management
  • Create automated spreadsheets for:
  • Daily cost monitoring
  • Job profitability
  • Vendor balances
  • Subcontractor debts
  • Cash flow projections
  • Build dashboards with:
  • KPIs
  • Charts
  • Calculated margins
  • Budget vs actual
  • Use advanced formulas:
  • QUERY()
  • ARRAYFORMULA()
  • IMPORTRANGE()
  • FILTER()
  • REGEX
  • App Script (bonus)


3. AI & Automation Development

Build automations that reduce manual work, such as:

  • Wells Fargo → Google Sheets transaction import
  • OCR receipt extraction (Home Depot, Lowe’s, Floor & Decor, Amazon)
  • JobTread → Sheets → Slack alerts
  • Automated job cost reports sent daily
  • AI categorization of transactions
  • AI forecasting for cash flow and profit
  • AI detection of budget overrun risks

Tools you’ll use:

  • ChatGPT
  • Zapier or Make.com
  • Google Workspace Automations
  • OCR tools (e.g., Docyt, Digits, Veryfi)
  • QuickBooks Online API (bonus)


4. Financial Forecasting
  • Build monthly + quarterly profit forecasts
  • Create cash flow models
  • Project job profitability before work begins
  • Compare projected vs actual performance weekly
  • Build charts showing:
  • Burn rate
  • Labor efficiency
  • Revenue projections
  • Identify financial bottlenecks early using AI pattern detection
5. SOPs, Reporting & Financial Governance
  • Build documented workflows and SOPs
  • Deliver daily/weekly financial summaries to CEO
  • Improve the efficiency of the finance stack
  • Recommend optimizations for budgeting and cash flow
Requirements Technical Skills
  • 3+ years bookkeeping experience
  • QuickBooks Online (required)
  • Construction accounting or job costing experience (preferred)
  • Fluent Portuguese + English
  • Strong Google Sheets skills (advanced formulas, dashboards)
  • Experience with Zapier, Make, or any automation tools
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Experience building financial forecasts
  • AI tools (ChatGPT, OCR, Docs AI)
Mindset & Qualities
  • Highly organized and accurate
  • Systems thinker who loves automation
  • Proactive problem solver
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Able to take a messy financial environment and structure it
Compensation
  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Performance incentives
  • Long-term, stable position
  • Work directly with U.S. CEO and leadership
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior AI-CFO role
How to Apply

Please submit:

  • CV/Resume
  • A short video introduction
  • Examples of dashboards you’ve built
  • Examples of automations you’ve created (Zapier/Sheets/AI)
  • Your experience with QuickBooks + construction job costing

title: Managing Director - Crypto Payment
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred



Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.



Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.



Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. title: Catalisadora de Resultados - Analista de Onboarding
description:
Tipo de Contrato: PJ

Modelo de trabalho: Home office (horários flexíveis)

Disponibilidade: Integral


ME DIZ UMA COISA...


O quão rápido os clientes da sua carteira vão conquistar o objetivo do onboarding?


Se você é do tipo de pessoa que vai buscar todo mês quebrar o próprio recorde...


Talvez faça sentido continuar lendo.


Cara leitora,


Caso esteja navegando sem rumo por listas intermináveis de vagas de “atendimento ao cliente”…


À beira de sucumbir ao tédio absoluto lendo “Buscamos uma profissional de CS com experiência em NPS… blá blá blá”…


Mas no fundo você quer ser a pessoa que muda o jogo nos primeiros dias, aquela que transforma uma compra empolgada em resultado real …


Segure-se.


Você está prestes a ler a descrição da vaga mais importante da sua vida.


E o motivo é simples:


Estamos buscando a Catalisadora de Primeiras Vitórias, uma profissional viciada em ouvir do cliente que...


\"valeu cada centavo\".


Overview da empresa


De fevereiro de 2022 para cá, meio bilhão é a soma total em vendas de tratamentos na área de harmonização facial a partir de métodos que fui autor ou co-autor. Possivelmente também o gestor que mais investiu em anúncios online nessa área.


Obviamente nossa trajetória até aqui não foi uma jornada solitária.


Nossa empresa é composta por…


20 dos marketeiros e vendedores mais lunáticos, apaixonados e selvagens que você já pensou em trabalhar junto…


A única dúvida que me resta agora é:


Será que você está à altura...?

Se você é...


Aquela que entende que as primeiras 48 horas definem o resto do contrato .


Que fica inconformada em ver uma cliente perdida , com acesso liberado, mas sem clareza, sem direção e sem ação.


Que se recusa a assistir alguém que investiu e confiou na gente desistir por confusão, demora ou falta de acompanhamento .


E que sabe que o sucesso não vem da plataforma, e sim de alguém que garante o começo certo .


Seu trabalho?


Eliminar obstáculos antes que virem desculpas .

Sua missão:


  • Onboarding em até 24h após a compra.
  • Cliente acessando tudo em até 48h (plataforma, comunidade, suporte, materiais)
  • Plano de ação de 30 dias claro, simples e executável
  • Primeiro marco de vitória em até 7 dias (ex: primeiro agendamento / primeira conversa qualificada / primeira ação que muda o jogo)
  • Primeira venda relevante em até 30 dias (adaptando meta ao estágio da cliente, sem fantasia)
  • Assinatura e formalização em até 24h (contrato + dados + regras do jogo)
  • Payback mapeado e acompanhado desde o primeiro contato
  • Suporte ATIVO : você vai atrás, não espera mensagem
  • Handoff perfeito para o time de ongoing: contexto, status, próximos passos e riscos mapeados
  • Zero churn nos primeiros 30 dias por falta de clareza / falta de ação / abandono


O que você realmente vai fazer (na prática)


  • Conduzir boas-vindas + organização do ambiente (acessos, grupos, orientações e alinhamento)
  • Call de onboarding com roteiro e diagnóstico rápido
  • Criar e acompanhar um plano de ação dos primeiros 30 dias
  • Fazer follow-ups de ativação (sem depender da cliente pedir)
  • Identificar travas e agir com antecedência (técnica, emocional, agenda, execução)
  • Garantir primeiro resultado documentado (prova social do onboarding)
  • Registrar tudo no CRM/Notion e entregar o handoff impecável pro ongoing
  • Trabalhar para reduzir hiperdisponibilidade: SLA, horários, fluxos, templates, automações e “perguntas frequentes”


Seus indicadores


  • Tempo médio para primeira reunião (meta: <24h)
  • Taxa de conclusão do setup inicial (meta: 100% em 48h)
  • Taxa de ativação em 7 dias (cliente executou o plano mínimo)
  • Tempo para primeira vitória (meta: até 7 dias)
  • Tempo para primeira venda relevante (meta: até 30 dias, por critérios)
  • Churn 7/15/30 dias (meta: 0%)
  • NPS do onboarding (meta: 9+)
  • % de handoffs “sem buraco” (ongoing recebe redondo, sem retrabalho)
  • Volume e qualidade de depoimentos de primeira vitória (por cohort)
  • Redução de chamados reativos no suporte (meta: cair mês a mês)


Seu superpoder


Você olha pra uma cliente que acabou de comprar e enxerga exatamente onde ela vai travar .


Antes dela perceber, você já mandou o tutorial, já organizou o caminho, já cobrou a ação certa, já destravou o próximo passo.


“Não sei por onde começar” vira:


“Já executei. Já entendi. Já tive resultado.” em poucos dias.


Você não espera o cliente pedir ajuda.


Você aparece antes do problema existir.

Algumas coisas legais...


  • Mínimo garantido + variável por performance da carteira (primeiras vitórias + ativação + NPS + churn zero)
  • Treinamentos diários com os melhores do mercado
  • Crescimento REAL em empresa em expansão acelerada
  • Participação nos maiores eventos da área (passagem e estadia pagas)
  • Home office com horários flexíveis, você faz sua rotina
  • Folga extra no seu aniversário


ÚLTIMO AVISO


Ainda não sabemos se daqui uma hora essa vaga vai estar disponível.


Se você leu até aqui, você entendeu: isso não é “atendimento”.


Isso é ativação, direção e resultado .


Só você não vem?


Nós nos movemos em um ritmo acelerado! Apenas os candidaturas dentro do que estamos buscando serão contatadas. Se você não foi convidada por whatsapp para uma entrevista dentro de 5 dias úteis após enviar sua inscrição, infelizmente, desta vez você não foi selecionada!


Palavras-chave relacionadas: onboarding, customer success, ativação de clientes, pós-vendas, implantação, sucesso do cliente, jornada inicial, retenção, prova social, depoimentos, cases, harmonização facial, estética, relacionamento com cliente, CS, mentoria, gestão de carteira.

title: Videomaker (TikTok)
description:
Visão geral do trabalho

Buscamos uma pessoa Videomaker (captação e/ou edição) para criar vídeos curtos de alta performance para redes sociais (principalmente TikTok, Reels e Shorts), com foco em retenção, clareza da mensagem e conversão. Esta posição atuará em parceria direta com time de marketing/performance e terá papel essencial no crescimento da marca, transformando briefings em criativos escaláveis (variações de hooks, ângulos e formatos) com velocidade e consistência.

Responsabilidades
  • Produzir vídeos curtos (UGC, review, demonstração, comparação, “problema → solução”, rotina, depoimento), do roteiro à versão final, seguindo o posicionamento da marca.
  • Criar variações de criativos para testes A/B (hooks, primeiro frame, CTA, ritmo, estrutura e narrativa), com entregas organizadas por versão.
  • Editar com foco em retenção: cortes dinâmicos, legendas claras, elementos visuais de apoio, ritmo e “pattern interrupts” quando necessário.
  • Garantir padrão técnico de áudio e imagem: correção básica de cor, tratamento de ruído, volume consistente, enquadramento e iluminação (quando houver captação).
  • Seguir e evoluir um guia de estilo da marca (tipografia de legendas, pacing, identidade visual, transições, trilhas, tom e linguagem).
  • Trabalhar com briefing e prazos curtos, mantendo organização de arquivos, nomenclatura, versões e backups.
  • Participar de ciclos de revisão e otimização: receber feedback, ajustar rapidamente e registrar aprendizados para próximos criativos.
  • Colaborar com marketing para interpretar dados de performance e propor melhorias (ex.: aumento de retenção nos primeiros 3s, clareza do benefício, prova social).
  • Entregar materiais em formatos adequados para plataformas (9:16, variações quando necessário) e com especificações de publicação.
Qualificações
  • Experiência comprovada em edição e/ou captação de vídeos para redes sociais (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Familiaridade com criativos de performance (DTC/e-commerce) e noções de métricas como retenção, CTR, CPA e taxa de conversão (mesmo que de forma básica).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição (ex.: Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, After Effects ou equivalente) e fluxo de legendas.
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para conduzir tarefas com pouca supervisão, alinhando expectativa de prazo e escopo.
  • Organização para trabalhar com volume e repetição (variações) sem perder qualidade.
  • Diferencial: experiência com UGC, direção de creators, motion simples, templates, gravação com celular, setup de luz/áudio, e conhecimento de anúncios (Spark/Meta).

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - BRA
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer


Reports To: IT Manager

Department : Information technology

Location : Blumenau, Brazil - Hybrid


At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.


MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting-edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.


With over 250 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA’s headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.


Job Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer-facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.


You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have a seamless experience with our cloud-hosted solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer-facing applications.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.
  • Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.
  • Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.
  • Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for cloud-related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing or consulting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding, technical account management, or solution architecture.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).



EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

O app permite que usuários consultem e interpretem rótulos de cosméticos, identificando ingredientes potencialmente problemáticos, alergênicos ou controversos, com base em literatura científica , dados regulatórios e critérios técnicos claros.

Nosso objetivo é democratizar o acesso à informação , sem influência da indústria cosmética, ajudando famílias a fazer escolhas mais seguras e conscientes.

Comunicação com usuários

  • Organizar listas de e-mail marketing (Brevo)
  • Apoiar disparos de comunicações e notificações aos usuários


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Excelente organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Boa comunicação escrita em português
  • Familiaridade com Excel (uso frequente de planilhas, filtros, organização de dados)
  • Capacidade de ler e compreender artigos científicos em inglês
  • Perfil responsável, MÉTODICO e confiável para lidar com dados

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia com suporte ao cliente

Perfil ideal

Esta vaga não é comercial , não é marketing estratégico e não é programação .

4 a 8 horas por dia, segunda a sexta.

Liberdade de horário de trabalho, desde que as tarefas sejam cumpridas no cronograma.

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. The professional will be responsible for building scalable solutions, maintaining engineering best practices, contributing to technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and agile environment.

Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).

Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Collaborate with multifunctional teams (product, design, QA, front‑end).

Nice-to-Have Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements


  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description:
1. About Us

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. Guided by our core belief—“We help people eat better, live better” —we’re bringing innovation to the global stage and building a better future for consumers and partners alike.


2. Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing and developing assigned accounts, supporting medium-sized chain brands to strengthen cooperation with the platform through brand marketing and promotional activities, contributing to the growth of transaction volume;
    executing the company’ssales strategy and supporting the achievement of sales targets;
  • Understand the business operations of the brands under responsibility based on their industry characteristics, and assist in developing and implementing food delivery solutions through basic business data analysis;
  • Maintain effective communication with the platform’s delivery team, acting as a liaison between the delivery team and assigned brands to help improve the overall delivery service experience;
  • Actively collect first-hand marketing information, user feedback, and local market insights, and provide practical and actionable suggestions to support business improvements.

3. Basic Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development in the food, restaurant, or consumer goods industry is preferred;
  • Good negotiation and market development skills, strong goal orientation, customer-focused mindset, and willingness to take on challenges;
  • Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in office software applications;
    experience working withreports and charts is required;
  • High level of integrity, responsibility, resilience, and teamwork;
    proactive and passionate about work;
  • English is mandatory.


4. Why Join Us?

Be part of the global expansion of Meituan’s food delivery revolution. At Keeta, you’ll experience firsthand the fast-paced growth and transformation of a cutting-edge industry. Join a diverse, world-class team that encourages bold thinking and global collaboration. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.


Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management.

É buscar a excelência, é fazer acontecer. É ser talentoso, inteligente, curioso e aceitar qualquer desafio. É se apresentar e defender as suas ideias. É colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar e ser apaixonado pelo que faz.

Porque somos digitais, mas também somos humanos. Se você, assim como nós, acredita que investimento não é sinônimo de terno e gravata, queremos conhecer você!

A empresa que investe em você! Descomplicamos o mercado financeiro para que nossos clientes consigam tomar boas decisões na hora de investir.

Buscar os melhores resultados para os clientes;

Ser apaixonado pelo que faz;

Aprender e melhorar sempre.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.

You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
  • Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (LinkedIn, sector-specific networks).
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.

  • Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
  • Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
  • Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.G., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
  • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.G., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.).
  • Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally >
    R$1M).
  • Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
  • Proficiency in CRM tools
  • Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
  • Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: International Buyer
description:
General Description


The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.


Detailed Description


Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.G., FAA, EASA).


Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.


Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.


Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.


Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.


Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.


Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.


Qualification Minimum Requirements


Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage


Educational:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English


Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)


Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

description:

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

title: Estagiário De Customer Support
description:
Sobre a DTX


A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.


Sobre o trabalho


Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de suporte ao cliente.

O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação de especialistas em atendimento ao cliente em unidades técnicas de MRO de trem de pouso.

O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de "job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de atendimento ao cliente "end-to-end" .


O estagiário de suporte ao cliente irá ajudar nossa equipe de atendimento ao cliente a garantir operações tranquilas e promover relacionamentos positivos com nossos clientes. Este estágio proporcionará uma valiosa experiência prática na indústria aeroespacial de MRO, particularmente na área de sistemas de trem de pouso. O estagiário apoiará as atividades diárias de atendimento ao cliente, ajudará na resolução de dúvidas dos clientes e contribuirá para o processo geral de satisfação do cliente.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar na resposta às perguntas dos clientes por telefone, e-mail ou chat, fornecendo informações relacionadas aos serviços de MRO do trem de pouso.
  • Coordenar com equipes internas, incluindo engenharia, operações e logística, para garantir a resolução oportuna das solicitações dos clientes.
  • Ajudar a manter registros precisos do cliente, garantindo que todas as interações sejam documentadas no sistema de CRM.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de cotações, cronogramas de serviços e relatórios para clientes.
  • Auxiliar no rastreamento e atualização dos pedidos dos clientes, garantindo a entrega pontual dos serviços.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de suporte ao cliente para garantir altos níveis de satisfação do cliente e acompanhar os problemas de serviço.
  • Participar de pesquisas de feedback do cliente e contribua para melhorar os processos de atendimento.
  • Ajudar em quaisquer tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao suporte ao cliente e entrada de dados.
  • Auxiliar na resolução de quaisquer problemas operacionais, incluindo atrasos ou discrepâncias de serviço, sob supervisão.

Competências a serem adquiridas:


Compreensão dos sistemas de trem de pouso:

  • Conhecimento básico dos componentes e funções dos sistemas de trem de pouso em aeronaves.
  • Familiaridade com práticas comuns de manutenção de trem de pouso, procedimentos de reparo e cronogramas de revisão.


Entrada de dados e gerenciamento de banco de dados:

  • Desenvolver habilidades na inserção e gerenciamento de grandes quantidades de dados técnicos, como solicitações de atendimento ao cliente, especificações de peças e relatórios de serviço.
  • Aprender a organizar e recuperar dados de forma eficiente para relatórios e análises.


Ferramentas de cotação e estimativa:

  • Ganhar exposição às ferramentas e processos usados para preparar cotações e estimativas de serviços, incluindo a compreensão de modelos de preços com base em custos de peças e horas de mão de obra.
  • Saber como ajudar na geração de estimativas de custos para reparos e revisões de trem de pouso.


Solução de problemas com problemas técnicos:

  • Desenvolver habilidades na identificação e análise de problemas técnicos relatados pelos clientes, como problemas com o desempenho do trem de pouso.
  • Aprender a coordenar com engenheiros e equipes técnicas para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas com eficiência.


Requisitos e informações da vaga:

  • O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em disciplina relevante.
  • A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
  • Duração de 12 meses.
  • O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.
  • Para essa vaga o inglês avançado ou fluente é obrigatório.

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

6) Gestão de estoque e prevenção de perdas : auxiliar na organização do estoque e na identificação de produtos com problemas, contribuindo para a prevenção de perdas.


7) Comunicação e trabalho em equipe : manter uma comunicação clara com os clientes e com a equipe, buscando soluções para eventuais problemas e colaborando com outras tarefas da loja, quando necessário.

title: Senior Full Stack .Net Engineer
description:
About You

You are a senior full stack engineer who enjoy owning features end-to-end, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and shaping delivery processes rather than simply executing tasks. You are comfortable working with legacy systems while helping modernize platforms that support high-visibility sports and real-time event management applications.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core and C# for building web applications and data APIs.
  • Proven experience using Entity Framework Core and LINQ for data access and business logic.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server , including writing complex queries and working with relational data models.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript , jQuery , and frontend development using MVC / Razor views .
  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs .
  • Exposure to real-time or event-driven features (e.G., SignalR or similar patterns).
  • General cloud literacy with exposure to Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Azure AD.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern version control workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of Web Components (e.G., Shadow DOM / Light DOM).
  • Excellent communication skills, able to participate in weekly client-facing meetings with US-based teams.
  • English proficiency is required, as you will be working directly with US clients in the sports industry.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining ASP.NET Core web applications and data APIs that support real-time sports and event management platforms.
  • Implementing backend logic using C#, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ, ensuring clean, maintainable code.
  • Developing frontend functionality using JavaScript, jQuery, Web Components, and Razor / MVC.
  • Writing and maintaining SQL Server queries to support application features.
  • Integrating with Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Azure AD as part of the platform ecosystem.
  • Participating in code reviews and contributing to continuous improvement of development practices.
  • Owning the quality of your deliverables by writing unit and end-to-end tests for critical business logic.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in both development and production environments.
  • Acting as a trusted senior contributor, helping to scale processes, shape workflows, and ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across projects.


Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
  • Proven experience developing frontend features using JavaScript, jQuery, and Razor / MVC views.
  • Senior delivery mindset with strong English communication skills.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations

title: Programador ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa:Oni Learning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, Oni Learning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de Oni Learning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!Descrição do Cargo:Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.Qualificações:
Desenvolvimento em Ruby:Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
Design de Software:Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
Controle de Versão:Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
Trabalho em Equipe:Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail: ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda
Head de Operações e Tecnologia
