title: Devops engineer
description:
Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
As a Dev Ops Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The Dev Ops engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teamsResponsibilities and Duties
Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions;
Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.Essential Skills
Experience in a Dev Ops role, with hands-on AWS experience;
Experience with Ia C tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Circle CI and Github Actions;
Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).Highly Desirable Skills
Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, Cloud Watch;
Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior full stack developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.
Nice to have:
Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.
Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy , gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em Open Shift ).
Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):
Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.
Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C#. NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.
Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.
Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.
Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).
Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).
Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente Open Shift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).
Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Assistente de sustentabilidade - vaga exclusiva para pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Auxiliar na administração e melhoria contínua dos sistemas de monitoramento de emissões de gases de efeito estufa, identificando oportunidades de evolução;
Realizar análises e consolidações de dados, utilizando Excel avançado e ferramentas de BI para gerar insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão;
Contribuir para rotinas de governança e compliance ESG, fortalecendo a confiabilidade e rastreabilidade das informações.

Pacote Office intermediário;

description:

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.
7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.
10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.
Qualifications Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and Type Script . Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB. Experience building REST / Graph QL APIs . Experience using AWS CDK or Infrastructure-as-Code tools.

title: Business development specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (Linked In, sector-specific networks).
Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients’ engineering challenges.
Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2 B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.). Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1 M).
Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
Proficiency in CRM tools
Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

title: Estagiário de customer support
description:
Sobre a DTX
A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.
Sobre o trabalho
Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de suporte ao cliente.
O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação de especialistas em atendimento ao cliente em unidades técnicas de MRO de trem de pouso.
O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de " job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de atendimento ao cliente "end-to-end" .
O estagiário de suporte ao cliente irá ajudar nossa equipe de atendimento ao cliente a garantir operações tranquilas e promover relacionamentos positivos com nossos clientes. Este estágio proporcionará uma valiosa experiência prática na indústria aeroespacial de MRO, particularmente na área de sistemas de trem de pouso. O estagiário apoiará as atividades diárias de atendimento ao cliente, ajudará na resolução de dúvidas dos clientes e contribuirá para o processo geral de satisfação do cliente.
Principais responsabilidades:
Auxiliar na resposta às perguntas dos clientes por telefone, e-mail ou chat, fornecendo informações relacionadas aos serviços de MRO do trem de pouso.
Coordenar com equipes internas, incluindo engenharia, operações e logística, para garantir a resolução oportuna das solicitações dos clientes.
Ajudar a manter registros precisos do cliente, garantindo que todas as interações sejam documentadas no sistema de CRM.
Apoiar na elaboração de cotações, cronogramas de serviços e relatórios para clientes.
Auxiliar no rastreamento e atualização dos pedidos dos clientes, garantindo a entrega pontual dos serviços.
Trabalhar com a equipe de suporte ao cliente para garantir altos níveis de satisfação do cliente e acompanhar os problemas de serviço.
Participar de pesquisas de feedback do cliente e contribua para melhorar os processos de atendimento.
Ajudar em quaisquer tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao suporte ao cliente e entrada de dados.
Auxiliar na resolução de quaisquer problemas operacionais, incluindo atrasos ou discrepâncias de serviço, sob supervisão.
Competências a serem adquiridas:
Compreensão dos sistemas de trem de pouso:
Conhecimento básico dos componentes e funções dos sistemas de trem de pouso em aeronaves.
Familiaridade com práticas comuns de manutenção de trem de pouso, procedimentos de reparo e cronogramas de revisão.
Entrada de dados e gerenciamento de banco de dados:
Desenvolver habilidades na inserção e gerenciamento de grandes quantidades de dados técnicos, como solicitações de atendimento ao cliente, especificações de peças e relatórios de serviço.
Aprender a organizar e recuperar dados de forma eficiente para relatórios e análises.
Ferramentas de cotação e estimativa:
Ganhar exposição às ferramentas e processos usados para preparar cotações e estimativas de serviços, incluindo a compreensão de modelos de preços com base em custos de peças e horas de mão de obra.
Saber como ajudar na geração de estimativas de custos para reparos e revisões de trem de pouso.
Solução de problemas com problemas técnicos:
Desenvolver habilidades na identificação e análise de problemas técnicos relatados pelos clientes, como problemas com o desempenho do trem de pouso.
Aprender a coordenar com engenheiros e equipes técnicas para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas com eficiência.

O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em disciplina relevante.
A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Senior delivery mindset with strong English communication skills.

Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.

Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.

Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.

not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:

We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs

Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective

... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing

You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

description:
Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior:

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de novas funcionalidades;
  • Ter responsabilidade para desenvolver em sistemas de importância crítica para a companhia;
  • Monitorar o desempenho e a aplicação das alterações dos sistemas;
  • Documentar as mudanças realizadas;
  • Criar e manter sistemas em produção levando em consideração requisitos não-funcionais, tais como: Desempenho, Escalabilidade, Segurança, Disponibilidade, Confiabilidade, Resiliência e Integrável com todo nosso ecossistema de aplicações.

O Que Esperamos De Você:

  • Saiba questionar gaps na arquitetura e no processo de desenvolvimento e propor soluções;
  • Saiba realizar inspeções no código e na documentação;
  • Implemente testes automatizados;
  • Desenvolva software em Go.
  • Tenha conhecimento de Bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Tenha conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Tenha capacidade de colaborar com a equipe em Code Reviews, pontuando boas práticas e possíveis melhorias.

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

description:
Design Director, UI/UX & Brand

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

This is about more than code style: it’s about making Sharewise a framework where developers can confidently adapt and extend features without breaking core stability.

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.
